definition: GuideGeek is an AI-powered travel assistant operated by publisher Matador Network.
details: It is accessed by users through Instagram, WhatsApp and Facebook Messenger to plan itineraries or provide travel tips and recommendations. It uses generative artificial intelligence technology from OpenAI. Destinations such as New York City, New Zealand and Greece have partnered with GuideGeek on custom versions of the technology.

explainer.lead: GuideGeek is a travel-planning chat assistant operated by Matador Network. It lets people ask for itineraries, tips, and recommendations through familiar messaging apps instead of a separate travel-planning interface.

tiers.eli5: GuideGeek is like texting a travel helper who can suggest what to do on a trip. You can message it through Instagram, WhatsApp, or Facebook Messenger. Some places, including New York City, New Zealand, and Greece, have their own custom versions.
tiers.practitioner: GuideGeek is an application-layer travel assistant built with generative AI technology from OpenAI, not a standalone model. Its user-facing integrations are Instagram, WhatsApp, and Facebook Messenger, with custom versions developed for destination partners. Implementers should distinguish the shared assistant concept from each destination-specific deployment.
tiers.paperLevel: GuideGeek can be described as an application function G(user travel request, deployment context) -> itinerary, travel tips, or recommendations, using OpenAI generative AI technology. Deployment context includes the messaging channel and, where applicable, a custom destination version. No distinct model architecture, training method, or evaluation metric is specified.

explainer.example: A traveler messaging GuideGeek on WhatsApp could ask for help planning a trip to Greece and receive a suggested itinerary along with travel tips. A Greek destination partner's custom version would provide a destination-specific form of the service.

explainer.intuition: The core idea is conversational trip planning inside apps people already use. GuideGeek combines a travel-focused assistant with generative AI and can be customized for particular destinations.
howItWorks: A user opens GuideGeek on Instagram, WhatsApp, or Facebook Messenger.
The user asks for an itinerary, travel tips, or recommendations.
GuideGeek uses OpenAI generative AI technology to produce a conversational response.
A destination partner's custom version can tailor the experience to that destination.
explainer.whyItMatters: GuideGeek places generative travel assistance directly within widely used messaging channels. Its destination partnerships also show how the same assistant concept can be adapted for particular places.
misconceptions: GuideGeek is a travel assistant, not a distinct generative AI model; it uses technology from OpenAI.
It is not limited to one universal deployment, because destination partners offer custom versions.
It is not confined to a dedicated app, since access is provided through three messaging platforms.
